help.title: Where do I find the link?
help.google: Google Calendar (on a computer): Settings → pick the calendar under “Settings for my calendars” → Integrate calendar → copy “Secret address in iCal format”.
help.outlook: Outlook / Microsoft 365: Settings → Calendar → Shared calendars → Publish a calendar → choose the calendar and “Can view all details” → Publish → copy the ICS link.
help.apple: iCloud: in Calendar, share the calendar as “Public Calendar” and copy its webcal:// link.
help.secret: Anyone with a secret link can see that calendar. If it leaks, reset it in Google or Outlook and subscribe again.
